name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 133 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Tel Aviv.
status.nb: 133 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Tel Aviv.

summary.en: Israeli forces have intensified operations in the occupied West Bank, demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead and launching a sweeping lockdown following a Hebron gunfight that left two soldiers and two gunmen dead. Simultaneously, an Israeli airstrike hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, captured on video, while Israeli attacks on West Bank olive farmers have escalated, killing several farmers. Prime Minister Netanyahu has announced an extensive military operation and closure of the West Bank in response to the Hebron attack. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker har økt operasjonene på den okkuperte Vestbredden, og har revet palestinske bygninger i Hebron etter at to israelske soldater ble skutt og drept, samt innført en omfattende nedstengning etter en skytekrig i Hebron som etterlot to soldater og to væpnede drepte. Samtidig traff et israelsk luftangrep en bygning i Nuseirat i Gaza, og dette ble filmet, mens israelske angrep på olivenbønder på Vestbredden har eskalert og drept flere bønder. Statsminister Netanyahu har kunngjort en omfattende militæroperasjon og stenging av Vestbredden som svar på angrepet i Hebron. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
